m1_incident.prompt: Minimal dark ambient documentary score for an air-accident investigation. A low sustained synth drone, a few sparse, distant piano notes, cold and clinical, slow, restrained, no drums, no percussion hits, no vocals, no melodic hook. Tension without drama.

m2_record.prompt: Slow investigative documentary underscore: a soft steady ticking pulse, low sustained strings and analog synth pads, cold and restrained, around 70 bpm, understated, no drums, no vocals, no big crescendo. Built to sit under a calm narrator.

m3_cascade.prompt: Restrained rising-tension documentary underscore: a low cello ostinato and a slowly swelling dark synth pad, building gradually over two minutes, cold, no drums, no vocals, no heroic brass.

m4_verdict.prompt: Sparse solemn documentary ending: a few quiet piano notes over a soft low string pad, reflective, understated, cold, slow, no drums, no vocals.

m5_factory.prompt: Cold, patient investigative documentary underscore for reading factory records: a quiet low synth pad, a faint muted pulse like a distant clock, occasional single low piano notes, slow, restrained, minor, no drums, no vocals, no build-up.

m6_system.prompt: Restrained analytical documentary underscore: soft low strings in slow sustained chords, a gentle muted synth arpeggio far in the background, sober and cold, steady, no drums, no vocals, no crescendo.
